title: DOUBLE APPLE  – VAPEHUB ULTRA 20000
description: DOUBLE APPLE is a tantalizing duet of crisp red and green apples that dances on your palate with every puff. Imagine biting into a juicy apple, its sweet and slightly tangy essence bursting forth, perfectly balanced by the refreshing crunch of its vibrant counterpart. With each inhale, experience a harmonious blend that invigorates your senses and brings a delightful freshness that lingers!
